Depends on the previous quests (handing in the addons takes 5 min)

The **Wayfarer** outfit is the final reward of the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest}. The two addons (Cape and Sedge Hat) are made by the {npc:Cranky Lizard Crone}, in Zao, from items you get in other quests: the {item:Old Cape} and the {item:Sedge Hat}. With everything complete you get the achievement **Peazzekeeper**.
